public abstract class Seq<A>
  extends Aggregate<A>
{
    public A head()
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public Seq<A> tail()
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public A at(int index)
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public Seq<A> append(A elem);
    public Seq<A> append(Aggregate<A> other);
    public Seq<A> prepend(A elem);
    public Seq<A> prepend(Aggregate<A> other);
    public Seq<A> insert(int at,
                         A elem)
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public abstract Seq<A> insert(int at,
                                  Aggregate<A> other)
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public int indexOf(A elem);
    public int indexOf((A) -> boolean p);
    public int lastIndexOf(A elem);
    public int lastIndexOf((A) -> boolean p);
    public Seq<A> subseq(int at)
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public Seq<A> subseq(int at,
                         int end);
    public Seq<A> subseq(int at,
                         (A) -> boolean p)
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public abstract Seq<A> subseq(int at,
                                  int end,
                                  (A) -> boolean p)
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public abstract Seq<A> sort((A, A) -> int ecompare);
    public abstract Seq<A> revert();
    public abstract <B> Seq<B> map((A) -> B f);
    public abstract Seq<A> filter((A) -> boolean p);
    public Seq();
}
